title: 4-player local input via Unity Input System
description: Map the four cabinet controls (joystick + one action button each) to fixed player slots and expose the Core InputSnapshot per player, with a keyboard dev fallback. Follows unity-input-4player skill (explicit device assignment, NOT press-to-join).
acceptance_criteria: An .inputactions asset defines a minimal map: Move (Vector2) and Action (button).
Four devices are assigned deterministically to player slots 0-3 so Rojo/Azul/Amarillo/Verde stay stable across restarts (explicit device list, not PlayerInputManager press-to-join).
A bridge produces a Barcade.Core InputSnapshot for each player every frame.
A keyboard fallback lets a single developer drive all 4 players for testing.
Regression locks plus a documented PlayMode/manual check confirm simulated inputs route to the correct slots.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
Done after a review-driven fix saga. Delivered: ArcadeControls.inputactions (Move Vector2 + Action button), ArcadeInputBridge (Barcade.Framework) implementing IReadOnlyPlayerInputs with deterministic device->slot assignment and keyboard dev-fallback (WASD/Arrows/IJKL/Numpad). Also the integration compile checkpoint: whole project compiles in Unity 6000.0.38f1; .meta files for Core/Framework generated+committed. Verification (orchestrator-run headless): EditMode 114/114, PlayMode 19/19, fast dotnet 113/113.
Review found 2 HIGH: (1) device isolation used bindingMask (by group) but never pinned device INSTANCES -> all joysticks drove all slots on the real cabinet; (2) PlayMode 'locks' never exercised the bridge end-to-end. Fixes: pin map.devices per slot (HIGH-1, fa30b5a base); added a public Initialize(asset, orderedDevices) seam so tests inject explicit devices, and 5 real PlayMode tests incl. a genuine device-isolation assert (HIGH-2). MEDIUMs: stable device sort by serial/product/deviceId (per-cabinet serial->slot map is future work); briefly mis-set includePlatforms:Editor on the PlayMode asmdef which broke EditMode, then reverted. Commits: f7aa0d9 (metas), d597f0b (input), 84551c8 (HIGH fixes), 0e34d42 (asmdef revert), fa30b5a (Initialize seam + real tests). Carry-forward: keyboard slots share Keyboard.current (isolated only by bindingMask) - dev fallback only; e2e scene (TASK-015) must assign _actionsAsset and ensure a single bootstrapped bridge.
